entities.summary: Nakasi or Nagashi is a traditional popular music form in Japan and Taiwan, most stereotypically associated with elements of working-class culture such as the old tea parlors and drinking bars. One explanation supposes that the word describes the migratory lifestyle of Nakasi musicians, who traditionally travelled from one tea parlor to another. nakasi is a music genre. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
